_comment: Preferred skill repos for every machine. skills-install reads this file; the design
is in README.md beside it. skillsync reads the same file for the restricted Claude
fallback, so the format is skillsync's, plus a codex list of native commands.
pin   - exact SHA for the skillsync fallback. Keep it equal to the ref in
~/.claude/settings.json. Bump both after you read the upstream diff.
codex - native Codex install commands, from each repo's README.

codex: npx -y skills add palkan/layered-rails-skills --skill layered-rails -a codex -g -y
